raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Motivation

The GDN fused decode projection + Conv1D path is gated on `_is_cuda`, so ROCm never takes it — although every prerequisite is already satisfied on HIP:

- `TritonGDNKernel.supports_packed_decode` is `not is_cpu() and not is_npu()`, i.e. true on HIP. At runtime the dispatcher reports `packed_decode=True` on gfx950.
- The kernels in `kernels/ops/attention/triton_gdn_fused_proj.py` are Triton, and the eligibility guard tests `tensor.is_cuda`, true for ROCm tensors.
- `SGLANG_ENABLE_GDN_DECODE_FUSED_PROJ_CONV` already defaults to `True`.

The backend advertises the capability and the model layer declines to use it. The sibling KDA Triton kernel makes the opposite call (`supports_packed_decode` excludes only cpu/npu/xpu).

Without the fusion, ROCm decode runs `fused_qkvzba_split_reshape_cat_contiguous` and then a separate `_causal_conv1d_update`. With it, both collapse into one kernel.

## Modifications

```diff
 _gdn_decode_fused_proj_conv = (
-    _is_cuda and envs.SGLANG_ENABLE_GDN_DECODE_FUSED_PROJ_CONV.get()
-)
+    _is_cuda or _is_hip
+) and envs.SGLANG_ENABLE_GDN_DECODE_FUSED_PROJ_CONV.get()
```

No new kernels or flags. `SGLANG_ENABLE_GDN_DECODE_FUSED_PROJ_CONV=0` remains the kill switch.

## Accuracy Tests

GSM8K, full 1319-question test set, `--thinking-mode qwen-3`, temperature 0, 2 runs per arm (2638 samples each), on 8x MI355X:

| arm | score |
|---|---:|
| stock | 0.9708 |
| #41677 (decode fused proj+conv) | 0.9666 |
| #41683 (prefill strided z) | 0.9663 |
| both | 0.9723 |

No significant difference against stock (two-proportion z-test: p = 0.38 / 0.34 / 0.74). Spread across arms is 0.61 pp against a 0.48 pp binomial standard error for a single run, and the both-patches arm scores highest — inconsistent with any additive degradation.

## Speed Tests and Profiling

8x MI355X (gfx950), TP=8, `amd/Qwen3.8-2.4T-A95B-Quark-MXFP4` (ships as `Qwen3_5MoeForCausalLM`; 69 of 92 layers are GDN), SGLang `v0.5.20-rocm10-mi35x`, decode 128/1024 @ concurrency 32, 4 runs per arm:

| metric | baseline | patched | delta |
|---|---:|---:|---:|
| mean ITL (ms) | 24.98 | 24.67 | **−1.22%** |
| output throughput (tok/s) | 1260.1 | 1275.8 | +1.25% |

Kernels on the GDN decode path (torch profiler, TP-0):

| baseline | patched |
|---|---|
| `fused_qkvzba_split_reshape_cat_contiguous_kernel` | `_fused_qkvzba_causal_conv1d_update_contiguous_kernel` |
| `_causal_conv1d_update_kernel` | |

Two kernels per GDN layer become one — 69 fewer launches per decode step.

## Checklist

- [x] Format your code according to [Format code with pre-commit](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#format-code-with-pre-commit).
- [ ] Add unit tests — covered by the existing `test/registered/kernels/ops/attention/test_gdn_decode_fused_proj_conv.py`; can extend its CI registration to a ROCm runner if preferred.
- [ ] Update documentation — no user-facing change; the env var and its default are unchanged.
- [x] Provide accuracy and speed benchmark results.
- [x] Follow the SGLang [code style guidance](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#code-style-guidance).

It looks like the PR's title does not fit the up-to date format (also check your second PR so we do not need to repeat the issue there ;) )

Format:
[Type] scope: title
or, with a hardware tag:
[Type] [Hardware] scope: title
Type must be one of: Feat, Fix, Refactor, Perf, Doc, Test, CI, Chore

As for the code, I would check 2 things:
-- no test for the feature on amd/rocm ci-registered, only cuda: https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/blob/main/test/registered/kernels/ops/attention/test_gdn_decode_fused_proj_conv.py#L15-L17
-- you may want to add the guard batch == 0 for  the fused gdn conf as e.g. in https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/blob/main/python/sglang/kernels/ops/attention/triton_gdn_fused_proj.py#L135-L136 or you need to make sure that batch == 0 never happens or it is safe. 

The numbers on the following set up shows that the change does what it promises:

ISL | OSL | conc | ITL unfused | ITL fused | ITL % | tput % | TTFT % | ITL saved (ms) | µs per fusion
-- | -- | -- | -- | -- | -- | -- | -- | -- | --
8,192 | 1,024 | 4 | 13.70 | 13.37 | −2.40 | +2.41 | −1.38 | 0.33 | 4.76
8,192 | 1,024 | 8 | 18.15 | 17.92 | −1.26 | +1.24 | +0.32 | 0.23 | 3.30
8,192 | 1,024 | 16 | 24.23 | 23.94 | −1.21 | +1.21 | −0.25 | 0.29 | 4.27
8,192 | 1,024 | 32 | 32.46 | 32.19 | −0.83 | +0.83 | +0.06 | 0.27 | 3.91
8,192 | 1,024 | 64 | 46.84 | 46.63 | −0.46 | +0.45 | +0.15 | 0.21 | 3.11
8,192 | 1,024 | 128 | 71.92 | 71.78 | −0.20 | +0.19 | +0.16 | 0.15 | 2.10
8,192 | 1,024 | 256 | 115.64 | 115.48 | −0.13 | +0.15 | +0.14 | 0.15 | 2.19
60,000 | 600 | 4 | 24.58 | 24.25 | −1.33 | +1.10 | +0.09 | 0.33 | 4.73
60,000 | 600 | 16 | 75.74 | 75.43 | −0.41 | +0.25 | +1.03 | 0.31 | 4.49
60,000 | 600 | 64 | 255.68 | 255.84 | +0.06 | −0.05 | −0.02 | −0.16 | −2.37
128,000 | 1,024 | 4 | 28.54 | 28.19 | −1.23 | +1.03 | +0.02 | 0.35 | 5.10
128,000 | 1,024 | 16 | 95.19 | 95.02 | −0.18 | +0.19 | −0.11 | 0.17 | 2.49

Our set up:

```
python3 -m sglang.launch_server \
    --model amd/Qwen3.8-2.4T-A95B-Quark-MXFP4 \
    --host 0.0.0.0 \
    --port 5060 \
    --tp-size 8 \
    --trust-remote-code \
    --linear-attn-backend triton \
    --attention-backend aiter \
    --kv-cache-dtype fp8_e4m3 \
    --mamba-ssm-dtype bfloat16 \
    --chunked-prefill-size 16384 \
    --max-prefill-tokens 16384 \
    --max-running-requests 256 \
    --page-size 16 \
    --disable-radix-cache \
    --mem-fraction-static 0.9 \
    --model-loader-extra-config '{"enable_multithread_load": true}' \
    --watchdog-timeout 12000
```

GPQA accuracy is fine, ~ 92% which we observe for the other set ups for the same model

Thanks for the independent runs.

**`batch == 0`.** You were right, and the gap is wider than the wrapper.

`fused_qkvzba_causal_conv1d_update_contiguous` was indeed the only one of the four wrappers without the guard (the others are at L135, L309, L716). But the guard that should have caught it first is in `gdn_backend.forward_decode` L693:

```python
if _is_hip and isinstance(mixed_qkv, torch.Tensor) and mixed_qkv.shape[0] == 0:
```

**ROCm test.** Added `register_amd_ci(est_time=7, stage="jit-kernel-unit", runner_config="amd")`, which resolves to the PR-blocking `jit-kernel-unit-test-amd` stage.
The author implemented the suggested improvements. I think it is time to enable  CI-tests so we can see if the changed code fits the "big picture".
